question: What alternative proportions may be used when beginning the wall width?
premises: A division into two parts is possible.
A single part may alternatively be used.
The wall width is to be begun accordingly.
inference: The wall width may be commenced using either a two-part or a one-part proportion.
uncertainties: The base unit to which these parts apply is not specified here.
plain_english: One should begin the wall width as two parts or alternatively as one part.
